final_prompt:
Make a careful final framing correction to this transparent planet game sprite.

Preserve the existing marginal world's subdued grey-khaki land, dusty sage plains, THREE small slate-teal inland seas with broad pale salt basins, two generous white polar caps, two faint cloud wisps, softly shaded warm-white upper-left illumination and dim lower-right side. Preserve its broad terrain composition and soft cinematic game illustration style. No new objects or extra details.

Enlarge the planet a little, keeping it precisely centered on a SQUARE canvas. The SOLID PLANETARY DISK itself, excluding any faint atmospheric edge, must occupy 90–92% of the canvas width and 90–92% of the height. Aim for 91%: at 1254 × 1254, the circular solid globe should extend approximately from x=56 to1198 and y=56 to1198. Even clear margin of around4.5% on all four sides. Make the outline a true circle, not an ellipse, with no clipping.

The very thin dusty-blue atmosphere must be faint and tightly contained at the disk edge, with clean anti-aliasing and fully transparent space beyond. Do not add a halo or bright blue emission. Keep broad smooth surface tones and do not increase sharpness, noise, fine relief, coastline detail or speckling. Keep the lower-right night side colored and legible. Around80% of the face is illuminated.

Deliver exactly ONE high-resolution square RGBA PNG with genuine transparent background, a single complete centered circular planet with even padding. No text, stars, other objects, shadows, decorative rings, framing or baked checkerboard.

iterations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE high-resolution square transparent RGBA planet sprite for the SYSTEM VIEW of Stellar Syndicates.

REFERENCE ROLE: The provided terrestrial planet image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for its complete spherical framing, readable large-scale features, natural color and cinematic volume. Create a NEW marginal celestial body with wholly new geography. Do not copy its green continents, blue ocean coverage, abundant clouds, granular terrain or bright blue atmospheric rim. The written instructions below take priority.

SUBJECT: One marginal world, nearly Earth-like but cold, dry and thin-aired, uninhabitable in the open. Its surface is predominantly broad cool khaki and grey-dun highlands, with wide flowing plains of dusty desaturated sage-green lichen. Exactly THREE small shrunken irregular slate-teal seas are spread across the visible face, each nested inside a larger softly shaped pale grey-ivory salt-flat basin. The water covers only a small fraction of the visible globe; there is no global ocean. Generous white polar caps at both the north and south poles read as large, calm ice masses with softly irregular boundaries. Only TWO very faint high cloud wisps, barely visible. A very thin, pale, dusty-blue atmospheric limb follows the sphere itself, noticeably fainter than the reference. Overall muted and cool, distinctly less blue and green than an Earth-like terrestrial world and cooler and greyer than an ochre desert planet.

STYLE: Premium softly shaded cinematic 3D game illustration with broad beautiful surface shapes. It must read clearly at 32–80 pixel diameter. Use simple medium-scale forms, smooth gradients and gently softened texture, with restrained subtle tonal variation and rounded spherical shading. No grain, fine cracks, dense craters, dune ripples, etched relief, microdetail, oversharpened satellite texture, speckled highlights, forests, cities or lights. Not flat vector, cartoon or low-poly.

COMPOSITION: Exactly ONE complete circular globe centered on a high-resolution square canvas. The solid planetary disk is approximately 90% of canvas width AND height, with 5% clear padding on every side. Perfectly circular silhouette, equal horizontal and vertical diameter. Entire globe and thin atmospheric edge fit inside the canvas without clipping.

LIGHTING: Broad soft warm-white key light from the upper left. Around 80% of the globe is legibly illuminated. A soft curved terminator shades the lower-right portion; that night side is dim but remains legible, never pure black. Broad smooth shading, no tiny specular glints.

BACKGROUND / OUTPUT: Genuinely transparent alpha outside the planetary silhouette and its very thin atmospheric limb. Deliver ONE high-resolution square RGBA game sprite, ideally 2048 × 2048 at native output quality. No opaque backdrop, no checkerboard baked into the art, no cast shadow. No sun, stars, moons, other planets, orbit lines, separate decorative circles, frames, floor, text, labels, watermark or contact sheet. Do not add any object other than this one planet.

Refine the attached marginal-world game sprite into a softer, cleaner SYSTEM VIEW asset. Keep its recognizable large-scale arrangement: three small slate-teal seas with pale salt basins; predominantly cool grey-khaki highlands and dusty sage plains; generous white north and south polar caps; warm-white upper-left illumination with a softly dim lower-right side. Preserve the nearly Earth-like but cold, dry, thin-aired identity and the muted natural palette.

CRITICAL ART CORRECTION: Redesign all surface rendering with broad, calm, gently blended shapes. Remove the sharp rugged mountain peaks, tiny ridges, granular relief, branching cracks, dark contour etching, speckling and photographic microtexture visible in the input. Use low rounded highland masses defined by broad subtle value changes, smooth wide sage plains, and clean softly irregular salt-basin boundaries. White polar caps must be simple generous ice masses with softly shaped edges, without a lacework of tiny ice fragments. Keep each of the THREE seas as one simple irregular water shape without satellite puddles. Just TWO faint high cloud wisps. Premium soft cinematic 3D game illustration, natural spherical volume and elegant medium-scale forms, made to read at 32–80 pixels. Surface color patches should feel softly painted and integrated into the sphere. No flat vector, cartoon or low-poly look; no obvious brush marks or noise. Do not merely blur the edges of the globe; keep a clean circular silhouette while simplifying the surface itself.

ATMOSPHERE: Reduce atmospheric intensity dramatically. An extremely narrow desaturated pale dusty-blue edge, almost imperceptible, fading smoothly into alpha. No electric cyan or saturated royal-blue edge, no luminous halo, no detached particles or stray colored pixels.

COMPOSITION: ONE complete perfectly circular globe centered on a square transparent RGBA canvas at high native resolution. The opaque planetary disk should fill 89–90% of BOTH canvas dimensions with even 5–5.5% fully transparent padding around it. Clean uninterrupted circular edge, entire sphere and thin atmosphere visible, no cropping. Around 80% of its face is legibly lit; the lower-right night side is gently shaded and still readable. No flat black region on the globe.

Output ONE high-resolution square transparent RGBA sprite, with genuinely empty alpha outside the globe. No backdrop or baked checkerboard. No other celestial bodies, sun, stars, objects, orbit rings, decorative borders, floor, cast shadow, text, label, watermark, or contact sheet.

iterations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium, softly shaded cinematic 3D GAME ILLUSTRATION of a marginal planet for the SYSTEM VIEW of Stellar Syndicates.

Output a high-resolution SQUARE PNG with genuine TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. One complete circular globe centered, diameter 88% of the canvas width and height, generous EVEN clear padding. The atmospheric edge stays inside the globe's silhouette, with a clean softly antialiased alpha boundary. No other elements whatsoever.

PLANET DESIGN: A cold, dry, thin-aired, nearly Earth-like world. Beautiful BROAD SMOOTH LANDSCAPE COLOR SHAPES cover the sphere: cool muted khaki and grey-dun highland regions, wide dusty sage-green lichen plains, exactly three small shrunken dark slate-teal inland seas each cradled in its own generously wide pale grey-ivory salt-flat basin. These are small seas, widely separated by dry land; no global ocean. A large calm white polar cap on top and a generous white polar cap on the bottom. The cap edges are softly irregular SIMPLE broad shapes. Only a couple of extremely faint delicate high cloud wisps. The atmospheric limb is an extremely thin, desaturated dusty-blue whisper just inside the silhouette, almost imperceptible. Overall COOL, MUTED and NATURAL. The planet is much less green and blue than an Earth-like world, and greyer and cooler than a warm ochre desert world.

ART DIRECTION: Beautiful smooth dimensional spherical rendering with large and medium-scale forms, very soft surface color transitions, rich but restrained muted color. This asset must read cleanly at ONLY 32–80 PIXELS across. Think elegant broad airbrushed planetary surface regions rather than satellite photography. The terrain has smoothly rounded shallow highlands defined ONLY by broad color and value shapes. The surface is almost velvety matte, with gently softened broad tonal variation. The salt basins have calm broad pale bands; the three small dark teal water shapes have simple softly irregular shores and no tiny islands or subsidiary lakes. Ice caps read as large smooth white regions.

LIGHTING: Broad soft warm-white upper-left illumination. Around 80% of the visible disk legibly illuminated. A soft curved terminator shades the lower-right fifth. Night side stays visibly colored and readable. Smooth cinematic spherical shading and no specular pinpoints.

STRICTLY EXCLUDE: grain, noise, fine ridges, mountain peaks, etched or sculpted relief, microcracks, fine cracks, rocky microtexture, intricate coastline lacework, dense craters, dune ripples, speckles, glints, oversharpening, forests, cities, lights. No flat vector style, cartoon or low-poly facets. No bright cyan glow, glowing halo, detached pixels or atmospheric aura outside the circular disk. No stars, suns, moons, extra planets, orbit lines, decorative circles, frames, floor, cast shadow, text, labels, watermark, background color or baked checkerboard. ONE globe only, centered on fully transparent square RGBA canvas with 6% clear padding on all sides.
